newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Controls gets Army engineers deal.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Controls gets Army engineers deal.

text.p: Johnson Controls Inc said Monday it has been award a contract by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to install and maintain utility monitoring and control systems around the world.
The contract is valued up to $140 million over the next five years, the automotive systems and building controls company said.
The systems are designed to reduce energy consumption and increase operational efficiency in military and other federal facilities.
Johnson Controls shares were down 3/4 at 42-3/4 Monday.
